blurb: The Marpole community is a largely residential neighbourhood with a population of 21,730. Marpole is one of Vancouver’s oldest neighbourhoods, settled in the 1860’s. It still retains the feel of a neighbourhood even though an active industrial area is to be found south of the branch on S.W. Marine Drive.
